title: should remove an Active member: icon, confirm dialog, DELETE, row gone
verifies: the remove icon opens the confirm dialog, DELETE fires to the member, and the row disappears after reload

title: should cancel the remove and leave the member untouched (no DELETE)
verifies: cancelling the confirm dialog closes it, issues no DELETE, and keeps the member row

title: should not render a remove icon on Pending invite rows
verifies: Active rows keep a remove icon while Pending invite rows have none

title: should expose the Remove action via the mobile more dropdown
verifies: on a narrow viewport the inline icon is hidden and the more-vert dropdown menu item opens the remove dialog

title: should fall back to the org id in the dialog title when the member has no name
verifies: the dialog title uses the org id when the member org name is empty

title: should disable the remove action while the DELETE is in flight
verifies: the remove action is disabled while the DELETE is pending and the flow completes once released
